PluginData.Author: empireu
PluginData.Tooltip: Replaces distant grids with impostors for performance.
PluginData.Description:
Replaces distant grids with a simple model that costs nothing to render. This makes rendering distant grids basically free. Meant for heavy combat in an SDX-like environment. No stability guarantees. If you have issues, report them to me.
To start, set a distance that makes the visual impact acceptable. P.S. if you zoom into the grid, it will get reverted, so don't get confused by that. WC-locked grids are also reverted.
